body: Correction to the checklist count: section 3 lists **13** existing original icons to convert, not 12. The 13 are Drill, Probe, 3D Finish, 5-axis Contour, 5-axis Parallel, Flow 5D, Swarf, Advanced Swarf, Rotary Contour, Rotary Parallel, Rotary Offset, Multi-axis Rough and Multi-axis Contour. The totals line should read "the 13 existing originals".

## Which icons can be borrowed from SolidCraft

**Yes, legally.**
- **Licence:** tangency-labs/solidcraft is **MIT OR Apache-2.0** (`LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`). Its `NOTICE` says "most bundled assets are drawn in code or contributed originally"; the only third-party assets it names are fonts.
- **AGENTS.md "Assets":** MIT and Apache-2.0 sets may be bundled without crediting end users. Copy SolidCraft's `LICENSE-MIT` text and copyright line ("Copyright (c) 2026 SolidCraft contributors") into `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`, and note which files came from it.
- **Not HSMWorks or Fusion material**, so the clean-room rule isn't touched.

**Their format matches the goal:**
- **What they are:** SVG masters in `assets/icons/ui/source/`, 378 SVGs in the repo.
- **Style rules** (`assets/icons/ui/STYLE_GUIDE.md`): `viewBox 0 0 64 64`, centred on (32,32), 2.55 outline / 4.25 action strokes, round caps and joins, palette-role colours.
- **Fit:** borrowed icons come out in the house style for free, and new CamCraft icons should be drawn to the same guide.
- **Reviewing:** SolidCraft ships a review tool (`assets/icons/ui/design/tools/icon_status.py --serve`) for checking icons at 16/24/48/64 px, in light and dark.

### Direct or near-direct matches (about 30)

| #661 item | SolidCraft icon | Fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Tabs:** CAM / machining workspace | `cam` | direct (their own CAM workspace icon) |
| 2D Chamfer, lathe Chamfering | `chamfer` | direct |
| Thread milling | `thread` | direct |
| Bore (milling) | `hole` | close |
| Slot | `slot` | direct |
| Trace | `trace` | direct |
| Contour | `boundary` | close |
| 2D Offset | `offset` | close |
| Circular | `circle` | base to adapt |
| Engrave | `text` / `emboss` | close |
| **Tree:** Part / model | `body` or `component` | direct |
| **Tree:** Stock | `box` / `bounding_solid` | direct |
| **Tree:** Work offset / WCS | `origin` (or `axis`) | direct |
| **Tree:** Operation group / folder | `folder` / `feature_group` | direct |
| **Tree:** Setup | `configuration_table` | loose, judge in review |
| **Status:** Warning or refused | `status_warning` / `status_error` | direct |
| **Status:** OK | `render_check` | close |
| **Status:** Stale | `status_recovery` or `update` | close |
| **Action:** Generate | `compute` (or `update`) | direct |
| **Action:** Simulate | `play` / `timeline_play` (and `stop`) | direct |
| **Action:** Show toolpaths | `eye` | direct (hide still needs drawing) |
| **Action:** Frame all | `fit` / `zoom` | direct |
| **Action:** Debug info | `bug_report` | direct |
| **Action:** Post | `export` / `send` | close |
| Rest machining (later) | `rest` | direct |
| Measure / probe result (later) | `measure` / `inspect` | close |

**Also from their set, covering the generic-chrome items:** `new`, `open`, `save`, `undo`, `redo`, `delete`, `settings`, the `prefs_*` family, `help`, `filter`, `select`. They arrive automatically once the kit (solidcraft#14251) is pinned. Before that, they can be copied.

### Still to draw, no SolidCraft counterpart (CAD has no equivalent)
- **Operations:**
  - Face, Pocket, Adaptive 2D, 3D Pocket and Deburr;
  - **all 13 turning operations**;
  - the 13 multi-axis, rotary, drilling and probing originals (converted to their style).
- **All 12 tool types:** end mill, ball, bull, drill, tap, boring bar, turning insert, grooving blade, threading insert, form tool, taper tool, probe.
- **Tabs:** 2D, 3D, Drill, Turn, Multi-axis, Simulate, Post. `cam` covers the overall workspace; these need their own glyphs or accent variants.
- **Tree rows:** Machine, Fixture.
- **Status:** Not generated.
- **Action:** Hide toolpaths.

**Net effect:** roughly **30 of the ~80 items** come from SolidCraft. That leaves about **50 to draw**, mostly the machining-specific operations, tools and turning set, drawn to SolidCraft's STYLE_GUIDE.

**Before copying:** confirm each SVG's current revision is accepted in their review (`design/review.json`), since some masters are still marked open. A Discord note to nateuax or jyviko that CamCraft is reusing them would be courteous.
